SELECT MAX(CAST(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda' AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0	----- bird -----	california_schools
1:
SELECT `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School'
AND `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3	----- bird -----	california_schools
